name: Warehouses
description: A SQL warehouse is a compute resource that lets you run SQL commands on data objects within Databricks SQL. Compute resources are infrastructure resources that provide processing capabilities in the cloud.

all_fields.name: auto_stop_mins
all_fields.description:
The amount of time in minutes that a SQL warehouse must be idle (i.e., no
RUNNING queries) before it is automatically stopped.

Supported values:
- Must be == 0 or >= 10 mins
- 0 indicates no autostop.

Defaults to 120 mins

all_fields.name: channel
all_fields.description: Channel Details

all_fields.name: cluster_size
all_fields.description:
Size of the clusters allocated for this warehouse.
Increasing the size of a spark cluster allows you to run larger queries on
it. If you want to increase the number of concurrent queries, please tune
max_num_clusters.

Supported values:
- 2X-Small
- X-Small
- Small
- Medium
- Large
- X-Large
- 2X-Large
- 3X-Large
- 4X-Large
- 5X-Large

all_fields.name: creator_name
all_fields.description: warehouse creator name

all_fields.name: customer_version_label
all_fields.description: Compute version label for a REALTIME warehouse. This field is output only.

all_fields.name: enable_photon
all_fields.description:
Configures whether the warehouse should use Photon optimized clusters.

Defaults to true.

all_fields.name: enable_serverless_compute
all_fields.description: Configures whether the warehouse should use serverless compute

all_fields.name: instance_profile_arn
all_fields.description: Deprecated. Instance profile used to pass IAM role to the cluster

all_fields.name: max_dbu
all_fields.description:
Maximum compute capacity of a real-time SQL warehouse, in DBU per hour.
Must be a multiple of 3 between 3 and 960. The effective maximum cannot be
lower than the warehouse's minimum capacity.

all_fields.name: max_num_clusters
all_fields.description:
Maximum number of clusters that the autoscaler will create to handle
concurrent queries.

Supported values:
- Must be >= min_num_clusters
- Must be <= 40.

Defaults to min_clusters if unset.

all_fields.name: min_num_clusters
all_fields.description:
Minimum number of available clusters that will be maintained for this SQL
warehouse. Increasing this will ensure that a larger number of clusters are
always running and therefore may reduce the cold start time for new
queries. This is similar to reserved vs. revocable cores in a resource
manager.

Supported values:
- Must be > 0
- Must be <= min(max_num_clusters, 30)

Defaults to 1

all_fields.name: name
all_fields.description:
Logical name for the cluster.

Supported values:
- Must be unique within an org.
- Must be less than 100 characters.

all_fields.name: reyden_cluster_size_multiplier
all_fields.description:
Cluster size multiplier for Reyden warehouses. Scales the effective compute
capacity relative to the nominal virtual cluster size. Only meaningful when
the warehouse is of Reyden type.

Accepted range: 1.0 to the workspace-configured maximum (decimals
allowed). The default maximum is 100.0.
- Values below 1.0 are normalized to 1.0.
- Values above the configured maximum are capped at that maximum.
- When absent, the warehouse is treated as having a multiplier of 1.0.

all_fields.name: spot_instance_policy
all_fields.description: Configurations whether the endpoint should use spot instances.

all_fields.name: statement_timeout
all_fields.description: Warehouse statement timeout in seconds.

all_fields.name: tags
all_fields.description:
A set of key-value pairs that will be tagged on all resources (e.g., AWS instances and EBS volumes) associated
with this SQL warehouse.

Supported values:
- Number of tags < 45.

all_fields.name: warehouse_type
all_fields.description:
Warehouse type: `PRO` or `CLASSIC`. If you want to use serverless compute,
you must set to `PRO` and also set the field `enable_serverless_compute` to `true`.

all_fields.name: page_token
all_fields.description:
A page token, received from a previous `ListWarehouses` call.
Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page; otherwise the first
will be retrieved.

When paginating, all other parameters provided to `ListWarehouses` must match
the call that provided the page token.

If not specified, SQL Gateway will use the user from the session header.
